description: AURA is a team of curious and creative students interested in Earth, space, science, and technology. We joined NASA Space Apps Challenge to learn, explore, and work together. Our goal is to use Earth data to better understand our planet and create a simple and useful idea that can help people learn more about Earth.
summary: NASA SPACE is a cross-platform application developed using Flutter and Dart, designed to provide comprehensive health monitoring for astronauts during space missions. It integrates physiological, psychological, environmental, and menstrual health modules to collect clinical data, record assessment results, identify potential risks, and provide preventive recommendations. Additionally, it incorporates psychological coping resources for emergency situations, including scenarios with limited internet connectivity. The system facilitates astronaut health monitoring, clinical data management, and early identification of conditions that may compromise their well-being. This project aims to contribute to risk prevention and the preservation of astronauts' physical and mental health in space environments.
details:
Our project involves the development of a mobile application that provides users with tools to track and evaluate their emotional well-being. It functions like any other mobile app: it is installed on a smartphone, allowing users to interact with its various features. Furthermore, it offers personalized support through virtual sessions and psychological assessments—using tests designed to identify the user's emotional state and provide relevant guidance.
Key benefits include accessibility, personalized support, and the ability to use the application both online and offline, making it versatile for various settings. The anticipated impact is positive, as the project aims to promote emotional well-being, improve access to psychological guidance, and facilitate the early identification of emotional needs.
The development process utilized tools and technologies such as HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Visual Studio Code, Git, and Flutter, along with a computer featuring a 32-bit or 64-bit architecture.
The project’s innovation lies in integrating emotional tracking, psychological assessments, and personalized support into a single mobile platform, while also incorporating offline functionality. Our team took into account factors such as accessibility, ease of use, connectivity, privacy, emotional well-being, and user needs, with the goal of creating an inclusive, practical, and innovative technological solution.
